replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
You map has been denied by the map developers for the following reasons.

Fronlines- The frontlines are in a very awkward position with nothing in the middle to help them out. Try to have islands where someone can bridge to them in a straight line.

Core placement- The core area is too close to spawn. Try moving it away from the spawn so it can't be camped.

You may resubmit the map after these edits have been done.
